skill.name: artifacts-builder
skill.description: Build complex Claude artifact projects with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components.
skill.summary: Creates and bundles multi-component React artifacts for Claude conversations.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign Markdown formatting, local version checks, or expected project file edits. The material risks are the shell-based installers, unpinned package downloads from npm or pnpm registries, and an opaque compressed component archive that should be easier to audit. No evidence of credential exfiltration or prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned package installation from external registries
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions, avoid latest where possible, document required network access, and consider disabling lifecycle scripts during install.

remediation.issue: Shell scripts modify and delete files in the caller project
remediation.suggestion: Validate the working directory before destructive actions, scope deletion to generated paths, and show the planned changes before running.

remediation.issue: Compressed component archive is opaque to static review
remediation.suggestion: Publish the component files as plain source or include a manifest and checksum verification before extraction.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned external package installation
semantic_findings.description: The setup and bundling scripts install packages from npm or pnpm registries, including latest create-vite behavior and a global pnpm install path. This can execute dependency lifecycle scripts and exposes users to supply-chain changes outside the skill repository.

content.value_statement: Complex Claude artifacts need more structure than one HTML file can provide. This skill scaffolds React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui projects, then bundles them into one shareable artifact.
actual_capabilities: Creates a React 18 and TypeScript project with Vite.
Configures Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, theme variables, and path aliases.
Installs Radix UI, shadcn/ui dependencies, and supporting React libraries.
Extracts a packaged set of shadcn/ui component files into the project.
Bundles a completed app into one self-contained HTML file with Parcel.
Provides workflow guidance for development, sharing, and optional testing.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and access to npm or pnpm registries.
Best suited for complex artifacts, not small single-file HTML snippets.
Scripts modify generated project files and install many dependencies.
Bundling can fail when project code uses unsupported browser or package features.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic artifact app
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new interactive artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use artifacts-builder to create a React artifact project named task-board. Build a simple task board with columns, cards, and local state.

prompt_templates.title: Add shadcn/ui components
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate artifact with reusable interface elements.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use artifacts-builder to create a customer feedback artifact. Use shadcn/ui cards, tabs, dialogs, forms, and toast notifications.

prompt_templates.title: Bundle an existing project
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert a finished artifact project into a shareable file.
prompt_templates.prompt: In my generated artifact project, use artifacts-builder to bundle the React app into one HTML file and report the output file name.

prompt_templates.title: Build a full workflow prototype
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced multi-view artifact with state and validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use artifacts-builder to create a multi-step onboarding prototype with routing-like navigation, form validation, progress state, and responsive shadcn/ui layouts.

output_examples.input: Create a project for an interactive pricing calculator artifact.
output_examples.output: A new React artifact project with Tailwind styling, component imports, and a calculator interface ready for development.

output_examples.input: Bundle my completed artifact into one file.
output_examples.output: A single bundle.html file that contains the app markup, styles, scripts, and dependencies needed for sharing.

output_examples.input: Make a polished artifact that uses dialogs, tables, tabs, and notifications.
output_examples.output: A Vite project with shadcn/ui components installed and wired into a responsive React experience.

best_practices: Use this skill when the artifact needs multiple components, state, or a reusable design system.
Review installed dependencies before running generated projects in sensitive environments.
Test the bundled HTML when the artifact depends on routing, browser APIs, or complex package behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for a small static page that can be written as one file.
Do not run the setup script in a directory that contains unrelated production files.
Do not assume registry packages are safe without reviewing dependency changes.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui project for complex Claude artifacts.

faq.question: Can it produce one shareable artifact file?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundle script builds the app and inlines assets into a single bundle.html file.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts install packages from npm or pnpm registries during setup and bundling.

faq.question: Is this useful for simple HTML artifacts?
faq.answer: Usually no. A simple artifact is better as a direct single-file implementation.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users review before running it?
faq.answer: Users should review the shell scripts, dependency installs, and generated project changes.
